name: userforged/shop
description: Ordering engine (catalog, cart, checkout) — canonical shop pattern, ports-based, framework-agnostic core.
_comment_require: The second group is transitional, not part of the target surface.
doctrine/* and symfony/http-foundation are only needed because the write side still
traverses Doctrine directly (EntityManagerInterface, OrderLinesType) and because
CartRepository is hardcoded to the HTTP session. Chantier F2-⑥ (persistence port)
and CartStorageInterface remove them. Declared meanwhile because a manifest that
understates its dependencies is worse than one that admits the debt.
